sections.heading: Scope of Cover
sections.body: Subject to the terms, conditions and exclusions of the policy, the Insurer will indemnify the Insured against all sums which the Insured shall become legally liable to pay as compensation in respect of accidental bodily injury (including death and disease) to any third party and accidental loss of or damage to third-party property, arising out of the Insured's business as a civil works contractor, including road, drainage, building and allied construction activities, occurring during the period of insurance. Legal costs and expenses incurred with the written consent of the Insurer are payable in addition, within the overall limit.

sections.heading: Territorial Limits and Jurisdiction
sections.body: Cover applies to occurrences within the Republic of India only. Any claim shall be subject to the jurisdiction of competent courts in India and Indian law shall apply.

sections.heading: Principal Exclusions
sections.body: Liability under any workmen's compensation or employee benefit law; damage to property owned by, in the custody of, or being worked upon by the Insured; liability assumed under contract unless such liability would have attached in the absence of the contract; gradual pollution or contamination; vibration, removal or weakening of support unless specifically endorsed; liability arising from motor vehicles licensed for road use; fines, penalties, punitive or exemplary damages; war, terrorism, nuclear risks; and professional liability for design or advice.

sections.heading: Important Conditions
sections.body: The Insured shall give immediate written notice to the Insurer of any occurrence likely to give rise to a claim and shall not admit liability, offer or make any payment without the Insurer's written consent. The Insured shall take all reasonable precautions to prevent accidents and comply with all statutory safety requirements at work sites. This certificate is issued for information only and is subject to the full policy wording, schedule and endorsements, which shall prevail in case of any inconsistency.

sections.heading: Grievance Redressal
sections.body: For any grievance, please write to the Grievance Officer, Konark General Insurance Company Ltd., at the registered office address or email grievance@konarkgeneral.example.in. If not resolved within 15 days, the Insured may approach the IRDAI Bima Bharosa portal or the Insurance Ombudsman, Lucknow, as per the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation.
